requirements.REQ_GENERATION_FENCE: Accepted source revision/digest authority is serialized with candidate validation, generation allocation, publication and acknowledgement; duplicates are no-ops and rejected/stale/conflicting candidates cannot mutate serving state.
requirements.REQ_SOURCE_AUTHORITY: Independent sources retain independent revision fences and last-accepted complete source material, including across restart.
requirements.REQ_IDENTITY_COMPATIBILITY: Canonical endpoint identity, semantic compatibility and membership incarnation preserve continuous runtime state while resetting state across material policy or remove/re-add boundaries.
requirements.REQ_SNAPSHOT_SELECTION: One request retains one leased generation for routing, retry and failover; affinity/retry selection revalidates canonical incarnation, lifecycle and health eligibility.
requirements.REQ_DRAIN_OWNERSHIP: Removed endpoints reject fresh work while legitimate old-generation traffic drains safely and lifecycle-owned state remains bounded.
requirements.REQ_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERY: Checkpoint recovery validates complete durable current state and falls back to a retained previous complete generation when current authority or body is invalid.
requirements.REQ_OBSERVABILITY: Status, metrics and lifecycle scopes report current state without unbounded stale scope growth.
requirements.REQ_PUBLIC_INTERFACE: The documented validate/serve CLI, operator endpoints and HTTP data plane retain normal observable behavior.
